evals.prompt: We want to set up a reusable AWS Glue connection (`rds-postgres-prod-orders`) to a private Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 16 instance (`orders-db.c123456.ap-south-1.rds.amazonaws.com:5432`, database `orders_prod`) inside VPC `vpc-0abc123` (`subnet-0111` in `ap-south-1a`, security group `sg-0222`). Walk me through the complete `connecting-to-data-source` workflow: credential registration (IAM DB auth vs Secrets Manager), VPC/subnet/SG/S3-endpoint requirements (`references/network-setup.md`), `aws glue create-connection`, and two-phase testing (Phase A `test-connection` + Phase B engine-level verification).
evals.expected_output: Complete Glue JDBC connection workflow covering candidate discovery, Secrets Manager vs IAM DB auth (`references/credential-security.md`), `PhysicalConnectionRequirements` (matching AZ `ap-south-1a`, self-referencing SG rule, S3 VPC gateway endpoint), `aws glue create-connection`, and two-phase verification (Phase A `aws glue test-connection` + Phase B minimal engine query).
expectations: Details the VPC networking prerequisites from `references/network-setup.md`: `PhysicalConnectionRequirements` (`SubnetId`, `SecurityGroupIdList`, and `AvailabilityZone` matching the subnet's AZ `ap-south-1a`), a self-referencing inbound security group rule for Glue ENIs, and an S3 VPC gateway endpoint so Glue jobs can read scripts/drivers.

Explains credential options (`references/credential-security.md`): storing credentials in AWS Secrets Manager referenced via `SECRET_ID` in `ConnectionProperties` or using RDS IAM database authentication (noting 15-minute token expiration).
Provides the `aws glue create-connection` command with `ConnectionType: JDBC`, `JDBC_CONNECTION_URL`, `JDBC_ENFORCE_SSL`, `SECRET_ID`, and `PhysicalConnectionRequirements`.

Describes the mandatory two-phase connection test: Phase A (`aws glue test-connection --connection-name rds-postgres-prod-orders`) followed by Phase B (engine-level verification via a minimal 1-row Glue ETL smoke test, Athena `SELECT 1`, or single-table crawler before handing off to `ingesting-into-data-lake`).

Recommends inspecting the connection via `aws glue get-connection --name oracle-erp-prod`, diagnosing the failure (`references/troubleshooting.md`), and updating in place with `aws glue update-connection` after approval.
